From a Hebrew perspective, the name Zolly reminds us of the wise and just King Solomon, a man of great wisdom and knowledge. From a Greek perspective, the name invokes the idea of life and living fully. These meanings come together to create a powerful symbol of a spiritually grounded, wise, and radiant individual who brings joy and life to the world.
